description: Faithful SHOC FFT: batched 512-point complex FFTs, one thread block per FFT, radix-8 decomposition with twiddles and shared-memory transposes (Volkov's FFT512_device / IFFT512_device kernels, verbatim). Each pass runs the forward then inverse batched FFT over all n_ffts blocks. Emits per-pass, per-kernel GPU times; GFLOPS is derived downstream.

scaling_param.name: n_ffts
scaling_param.description: Number of independent 512-point FFTs (one thread block each)

non_scaling_params.name: precision
non_scaling_params.description: Floating-point precision (float2 or double2 kernel instantiation)

non_scaling_params.name: fft_size
non_scaling_params.description: Points per FFT (compile-time fixed at 512 in the SHOC kernels)
